documentation.content: The run-daily Cloud Run service returned at least one HTTP 5xx response in a 5-minute window. This typically means the function crashed before releasing the lock. Check Cloud Logging for `run_daily failed` entries.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="run-daily" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code_class="5xx"
